questions.show:
PROMOTIONAL TEXT (can change later without a new build)
HOAhx is being built for communities that want a clear view of payments, requests and decisions. Sign in with the invitation from your community.

KEYWORDS
HOA,homeowners,association,dues,community,board,neighbors,maintenance,requests,documents,vote,HOA fees

DESCRIPTION
HOA HX is the Home Experience Platform for community living: clear about what is happening, connected to the people who can move it forward, and accountable about who owns each step.

HOA living, made clear.

HOA HX is for homeowners first, then the volunteer boards who run self-managed communities. You get in by invitation from your community; there is nothing to buy from HOA HX and homeowners never pay HOA HX.

AVAILABLE AT LAUNCH

• Your dues, plainly. See what you owe, why, and your payment history, and download a receipt. Pay your community's dues by card or bank account. Payments go to your community's own merchant account through the payment provider NMI. Card and bank details are typed into the payment provider's own fields; HOA HX never sees or stores them.

• Requests with a clear next step. Report a maintenance problem, add a photo from your camera, and follow it from received to done: what happens next, who is responsible, and the full history.

• Your home and household. Keep your household, pets, vehicles and guest passes in one place. Choose what neighbors can see of you in the community directory; the default is name only.

• Documents and notices. Read your community's announcements and documents, with every earlier version kept.

• Your community's decisions. Vote, see meetings and events, and reserve shared spaces where your community offers them.

• Your account, your say. Close your account in the app at any time, or ask HOA HX Support for a copy of your own information or its deletion. Closing your account ends your access. It does not erase the community's official records, such as payments, requests and notices; they stay with the community under its retention schedule.

• For boards. Board members get a financial ledger, request review and resident management, and sign in with two-step verification.

COMING SOON

• Notifications on your phone for payments, requests and notices.
• Passkey sign-in.
• Self-service download of your own data.

HOA HX has not launched yet. Features can differ from one community to the next, because each community chooses what it turns on.

Questions? hello@hoahx.com

questions.why: Each answer comes from what the app does today. Apple's "Data Not Collected" cannot be chosen, and "used to track you" stays empty.
questions.show:
HEADLINE ANSWERS
• Tracking people across other companies' apps and sites: No.
• Data sold or shared for advertising: No.
• Data linked to the person: Yes, all of it (every record belongs to a signed-in account).
• Data encrypted in transit: Yes.
• The person can ask for deletion: Yes. They can close the account in the app, or ask HOA HX Support for a copy or deletion of their own information.

WHAT IS COLLECTED (every row is linked to the person, none is used to track them; the purpose is always App Functionality)
• Name: on accounts, requests and the community's roster.
• Email address: the sign-in; invitations and notices are sent by email.
• Phone number: only when a person adds one (a directory phone they choose to show, or text-message two-step sign-in).
• Physical address: the person's home in the community.
• Payment info: not collected by HOA HX. Card and bank details are typed into the payment provider's own fields.
• Other financial info and purchase history: dues charges, payments, balance and receipts for the person's own home. Homeowners never pay HOA HX.
• Photos: only when the person attaches one to a maintenance request.
• Customer support: maintenance requests, reports and messages to the community.
• Other user content: violation notices and appeals, architectural requests, pets, vehicles, guest passes, votes, documents, announcements.
• User ID: the account's sign-in id.
• Device ID: the push-notification token (not the advertising ID), listed so notifications can work later. One per phone, removed on sign-out.

NOT COLLECTED: location, contacts, health, browsing history, search history, analytics.
